automated_tests.scope: Final core suite (44), startup (3) and Streamlit interface tests (7). The UI matrix covers 100 team/page combinations and 20 team/theme changes.

team_scenarios.rule: Every successful plan independently checked for 11 distinct players, all 20 overs, no consecutive overs, workload/phase caps, exclusions and locks. Explicitly impossible cases rejected.

raw_reconciliation.scope: Full supplied archive reconciliation; target overs interpreted as cricket over.ball notation, not decimal overs. Fallback and analytical death labels are not proof of official field restrictions or source authenticity.

checks: Word guide contains instructions and chapters
Source ZIP complete and excludes credentials/runtime
Scouting CSV retains context and version
XI CSV has 11 players and 120 legal balls
XI pack has legal complete schedule
Checked brief pack matches manifest fingerprint
Journal export scoped to selected team
Forecast export has target, teams and method provenance
Credentials hidden and test disabled without override
Second visitor cannot read first journal
Mobile Home has no page overflow and respects reduced motion
Mobile guided scenario has no horizontal page overflow
browser.scope: Real local Chromium, isolated synthetic session data, desktop and 390px mobile. No hosted rebuild or live provider quality claim.

temporal_scouting_study.scope: Rolling-origin descriptive study, not evidence of scouting superiority. See scouting_benchmark_report.json.

limits: Hosted Streamlit rebuild and live DeepSeek connectivity/quality have not been verified from this environment.
Squad verification is partial. Current eligibility, availability, acquisition status and market prices require review.
No demonstrated forecast advantage. The app serves a training-derived baseline.
Public browser-session scoping is not authenticated durable team access.
Full Impact Player and competition regulation certification are outside this twenty-over model.
additional_checks: Source ZIP retains platform launch scripts and excludes secrets/runtime records.
Unselected players with a justified utility override retain the correct assumption status.
